title: Very light, thin, and handles get hot quickly.
text: Very light, thin, and handles get hot quickly.. This is a decent set for the price, however you get what you pay for. The pans are very lightweight and very thin as well. The handles are extremely thin and get hot quickly so make sure you have potholders handy! Have used a few times and they are truly nonstick which is a plus. The color is pretty and they have a nice shine to them. Very easy to clean too. The spatula and spoon that come with the set feel like cheap plastic though. This is a nice starter set and I would say it’s worth the price, just not the best out there.
